import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2000010;
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static final long BASE = 1000000L;
    static long total_numbers, current_index, total_answer;
    static long[] prefix_sum = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] digit_vectors = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            digit_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long readLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        return Long.parseLong(line.trim());
    }

    static long mod_value(long x) {
        return ((x % MOD2) + MOD2) % MOD2;
    }

    static void generate_sequence(long start, int depth) {
        current_index++;
        long val = mod_value(current_index - start);
        digit_vectors[depth].add(val);
        prefix_sum[depth] = (prefix_sum[depth] + val) % MOD1;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            generate_sequence(start * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process_sequence(long number) {
        if (number > n) return;
        if (number * BASE + (BASE - 1) <= n && number * BASE * 10 > n) {
            long prev_idx = current_index;
            for (int level = 0, multiplier = 1; level <= 6; level++, multiplier *= 10) {
                List<Long> vec = digit_vectors[level];
                int size = vec.size();
                long delta = mod_value(prev_idx - number * multiplier);
                int position = lowerBound(vec, MOD2 - delta);
                total_answer = (total_answer + delta * size + prefix_sum[level] - MOD1 * (size - position)) % MOD1;
                current_index += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        current_index++;
        total_answer = (total_answer + mod_value(current_index - number)) % MOD1;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            process_sequence(number * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate_sequence(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_vectors[i]);
        }
        current_index = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process_sequence(i);
        }
        System.out.println((total_answer + MOD1) % MOD1);
    }
}
